> "Good question. That feature isn't feasible with the current data model because wholesale orders don't carry a per-item roast date. A workaround: use the batch number on the invoice and we can add a lookup endpoint. Happy to walk through it Tuesday."

So you told him no, explained that wholesale orders don't carry a per-item roast date, and suggested looking it up by the batch number on the invoice instead, through a lookup endpoint you could add. You also offered to go over it at the Tuesday 2pm walkthrough. I can see what you typed, but not whether the email was actually sent.

If you meant a different request, two other emails are close:
- **SMS order alerts** (Tue Sep 29, "Re: 4 feature requests"): you told him "not this year, sorry." In your follow-up the same day, you also gave him the timelines Dana confirmed for the other three requests.
- **Yesterday at 2:09 PM** ("Re: Feature request - Tom Alvarez"): you told him a suggestion was "on the roadmap for Q3." That wasn't a no.

Your "Tom call talking points" note from yesterday may cover this too, but I can't see what's in it.
